source: MoneyPuck.com game-by-game skater files; ESPN box scores for new games
scope: regular-season games with 10+ minutes of ice time; skaters with 40+ of them

weighting.r: Gaussian-copula (tetrachoric) correlation of the two legs' hit / miss indicators at those exact lines, hits centred on the skater's own rate each season
weighting.pair_values: [shrunk r, own r, weight on own, hit rate leg 1, hit rate leg 2]

shrinkage.method: empirical Bayes toward the position's average r for the same pair of lines; noise evaluated at that average; tau held to 0.02-0.12
